_notes.max_derivative_gap_frames: Fixed at 0: no derivative across any missing frame. Non-zero bridging is refused by the code until the real PIE gap distribution has been reviewed.
_notes.min_heading_speed_px_per_s: 0.0 means only an exactly zero velocity has no heading. No threshold is chosen without evidence; the quality report gives heading counts at the sensitivity values instead.
_notes.smoothing: Disabled by default. Options: causal_ema (existing Stage 4 fixed-alpha EMA, alpha in (0,1]) or time_aware_ema (alpha_t = 1 - exp(-dt/tau_s)). Raw estimates are always kept.
_notes.continuity: Every anomaly threshold is reported as a sensitivity table; none is used to change or merge tracks.
